notes.title: 💔 Major Update: Smarter Bosses, Smoother Fights & New Foes!
notes.content:
🔧 Update Highlights

🧠 Smarter Bosses, Bigger Challenge
We've enhanced Boss AI and actions—they're more tactical, aggressive, and unpredictable. Get ready to rethink your strategy!

🎮 Combat Tuning & Movement Polish
Player movement is now more fluid and responsive, making every dodge, dash, and hit feel more satisfying.

👹 A New Enemy Appears
A new enemy type has entered the arena. Adapt quickly or get crushed under pressure!

⚖️ Difficulty Rebalanced
We’ve fine-tuned game difficulty to ensure a more balanced but challenging experience for both new and veteran fighters.

🔊 Audio Enhancements
Sound effects and audio cues have been tweaked for better clarity, feedback, and immersion in the chaos of battle.

🌍 Improved Localization
Updated translations across supported languages for a clearer, smoother experience for players worldwide.

Thank you for fighting in The Breakup Arena! Your feedback drives us—keep sharing your thoughts, and get ready for more chaos in the next update.

— Caicai Studio
